correctness.rationale: The proof reduces normality to integral closedness of the square, derives an exact numerical-semigroup interval criterion for every possible x-degree-one obstruction, and evaluates that criterion in the even, odd non-coprime, and odd coprime cases. An independent finite enumeration of the exact interval criterion over 14,751 parameter pairs agrees with the closed classification.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Reid--Roberts--Vitulli give the general square criterion, a necessary semigroup condition, and the example (2,3,7); Coughlin treats the consecutive family; later work gives broader sufficient conditions. Targeted exact and synonymous searches found no classification of the full (2,b,c) slice or the midpoint criterion, and no overlapping SCOPE record was found. The uninspected full Coughlin dissertation remains a residual coverage risk.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete arithmetic classification of an infinite two-parameter slice of a published three-variable open problem, makes the classical (2,3,7) obstruction part of a general mechanism, and provides explicit witnesses for every non-normal case.
